results.description:
BRACE FOR IMPACT challenges everything you’ve been taught about money and ministry. What if building wealth isn’t just about securing your future and blessing others—but a weapon to push back the forces of evil?

In this unapologetic guide to faith and finances, brothers and entrepreneurs David and Jason Benham reveal the collision course between two kingdoms and how your need for income positions you for eternal impact.

Sharing their journey from professional baseball to business success—and the fiery trials they faced along the way—they show how wealth isn’t the goal but the tool. It’s the fuel for living a life of purpose, shaping culture, and bringing the Kingdom of Light into dark places.

Packed with biblical wisdom, real-life stories, and a no-nonsense approach, Brace for Impact will teach you:

* What the Bible says about wealth and how to use it to bless your family while making a difference in the world.

* The three dimensions of wealth and how they work together to unlock Kingdom potential.

* How to create passive income so you can stop trading time for money and start using it to do what you love.

* A simple method for uncovering your why so you can invest your resources with intention and purpose.

* A six-step roadmap to break free from the grind and achieve a level of freedom you never thought possible.

This is not just a book about making money—it’s a battle plan for leveraging your resources to shine your light, overcome the darkness, and leave an indelible mark on the world for Christ.
